title: Y Combinator’s Garry Tan wants U.S. open-weight AI labs to ‘distill’ frontier models, too
title_zh: Y 联合体的Garry Tan希望美国开放的AI实验室也"继续"前沿模型
mode: 短句精读 · 未获全文转载授权
paragraphs: Y Combinator’s Garry Tan wants U.S. open-weight AI labs to ‘distill’ frontier models, too. Tan argues that frontier models themselves trained on public human knowledge
Y Compator的Garry Tan希望美国开放的人工智能实验室也能“继续”前沿模型。 Tan认为,前沿模型本身受过公共人类知识的培训。
